definitions.explanation: The final period of the year, especially December.
The time when day ends and night begins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暮|く}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: The end of the year is busy.

examples.japanese: {暮|く}れ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{押|お}し{迫|せま}る→押し迫る：27886_oshisemaru⟧。
⟦{夕|ゆう}{暮|ぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧。

examples.english: The days are short in late autumn.

examples.japanese: {暮|く}れ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧、⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦や→や：10080_ya⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: From year-end through New Year, I spent each day busy with visiting relatives and shopping.

notes:
{暮|く}れ refers to endings - of the year or the day.

YEAR-END USAGE:
- ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暮|く}れ (year end)
- {暮|く}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧ (year-end greetings)
- {暮|く}れ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{押|お}し{迫|せま}る→押し迫る：27886_oshisemaru⟧ (year-end approaches)

DAY-END USAGE:
- ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧{暮|ぐ}れ (dusk, sunset)
- ⟦{夕|ゆう}{暮|ぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧ (evening, dusk)

SEASONAL EXPRESSIONS:
- {暮|く}れ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ (from year-end through New Year)
- ⟦お{歳暮|せいぼ}→お歳暮：06126_oseibo⟧ (year-end gift)

CONTRAST:
- {暮|く}れ (end of year/day)
- ⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧ (beginning, dawn)
